pirate software: It is against the law to pirate software, because the people who made it lose the money they deserve.
盜版軟體是違法的，因為開發它的人會損失應得的收入。
pirated DVDs: The police found thousands of pirated DVDs of new movies in the night market and arrested the seller.
警方在夜市查獲數千張新電影的盜版光碟，並逮捕了賣家。
pirate a brand: Some factories pirate a brand by copying its logo and selling cheap fake bags online.
有些工廠藉由抄襲商標、在網路上販售廉價假包來仿冒品牌。
pitch an idea: In the meeting, each student had three minutes to pitch an idea for the school festival to the teachers.
會議中，每位學生有三分鐘向老師推銷自己對校慶的點子。
pitch a tent: When we arrived at the campsite, it was already dark, so it was hard to pitch a tent.
我們抵達營地時天已經黑了，所以很難搭帳篷。
pitch in: If everyone in the class is willing to pitch in, we can clean the whole classroom in ten minutes.
如果班上每個人都願意幫忙，我們十分鐘就能把整間教室打掃乾淨。
pitch a product: The salesman had only one minute on TV to pitch a product, so he spoke quickly about its best features.
這位業務員在電視上只有一分鐘推銷產品，所以他快速介紹產品最棒的特色。
pitch at beginners: The textbook is easy to read because the writers decided to pitch it at beginners who know little English.
這本課本很好讀，因為作者決定把它針對英文程度不高的初學者。
a sales pitch: The woman at the door gave us a long sales pitch about her water machine, but we didn't buy it.
門口的女士對我們說了一大段推銷她淨水器的話術，但我們沒有買。
pity the poor: The story teaches us to pity the poor and share food with people who have nothing to eat.
這個故事教導我們同情窮人，並把食物分給沒東西吃的人。
take pity on: The kind old woman decided to take pity on the hungry kitten and brought it home with her.
那位好心的老婦人決定憐憫那隻飢餓的小貓，把牠帶回家。
it's a pity: It's a pity that you can't come to my birthday party, because I prepared your favorite cake.
真可惜你不能來我的生日派對，因為我準備了你最愛的蛋糕。
self-pity: Instead of sitting in his room full of self-pity, he went out and started practicing for the next game.
他沒有窩在房間裡自憐，而是出門開始為下一場比賽練習。
place an order: If you place an order on the website before noon, the books will arrive at your house tomorrow.
如果你在中午前在網站上下訂單，書明天就會送到你家。
place emphasis on: Our school likes to place emphasis on teamwork, so most projects are done in small groups.
我們學校喜歡強調團隊合作，所以大部分專題都以小組方式完成。
place trust in: It takes a long time to place trust in someone again after they have lied to you.
在某人對你說謊之後，要再次信任他需要很長的時間。
place a bet: My uncle went to the horse races to place a bet, but he lost all the money he brought.
我叔叔去賽馬場下注，但他把帶去的錢全輸光了。
place the blame: When the project failed, the manager tried to place the blame on his workers instead of himself.
專案失敗時，經理試圖把錯歸咎於員工，而不是他自己。
place first: After months of hard practice, our school band hopes to place first in the national music contest this year.
經過數月的努力練習，我們學校樂隊希望在今年的全國音樂比賽中得到第一名。
place an ad: The family decided to place an ad in the local newspaper to find their lost dog.
這家人決定在當地報紙刊登廣告，尋找他們走失的狗。
be plagued by injuries: The famous player has been plagued by injuries this season, so he has missed most of the games.
這位知名球員本季飽受傷病困擾，所以錯過了大部分的比賽。
plague the project: Money problems and bad weather continued to plague the project, so the new bridge was finished two years late.
資金問題和惡劣天氣持續困擾著這個專案，所以新橋晚了兩年才完工。
plagued with problems: The new phone was plagued with problems, such as a weak battery and a screen that often froze.
這支新手機問題纏身，例如電池續航力差，螢幕也常常當機。
avoid like the plague: My brother hates vegetables so much that he will avoid broccoli like the plague at every meal.
我弟弟非常討厭蔬菜，每餐都對花椰菜避之唯恐不及。
plant evidence: The man said the police had planted evidence in his car, but the judge did not believe him.
那名男子說警察在他車上栽贓證據，但法官不相信他。
plant an idea: A good teacher can plant an idea in a student's mind that grows into a lifelong interest.
好老師能在學生心中植入一個想法，發展成一輩子的興趣。
plant a bomb: The movie is about a hero who must find out where the bad guys plan to plant a bomb in the city.
這部電影講的是一位英雄必須查出壞人打算在城市哪裡放置炸彈。
plant a spy: The company secretly tried to plant a spy in its rival's office to learn about their new products.
這家公司偷偷想在對手的辦公室安插間諜，以打探他們的新產品。
plant doubts: His strange answers began to plant doubts in my mind about whether he was telling the truth.
他奇怪的回答開始在我心中埋下疑慮，讓我懷疑他是否說了實話。
plant trees: Every spring, our students plant trees along the river to make the area greener and cleaner.
每年春天，我們的學生都會沿著河邊種樹，讓這一帶更綠、更乾淨。
